New exclusions: digital gaming (MCC 7993, 7994, 5816), tolls (4784), government (9222, 9311, 9402), in addition to existing: utility, insurance, fuel, rent, wallet, school/education, JEWELRY, railways, Merchant/Flexipay EMI.
